title: Abduction servo cradle, left
note: Print flange down. FL and RL share this part.

title: Abduction servo cradle, right
note: Mirror of the left cradle. FR and RR.

title: Coxa link, left
note: Print proximal flange down. Light supports under the arch.

title: Spherical tread foot
note: TPU 95A. 3 perimeters, 20% infill. Ball down if the slicer allows.

title: 25T clamping horn
note: Print flange down. 100% infill. Ream the bore to 6.1 only if the spline is tight — bore is modelled 6.1 mm.

title: Standard digital servo
note: IP-rated 25 kg·cm standard servo, 180° or 270° programmable. 12 leg + yaw + shoulder + elbow.

title: Flight pack
note: 2200 mAh ≥30C, XT30. Charge outside the robot.

title: Computer
note: Or any 65×30 class SBC. USB gadget for bench bring-up.

title: Servo driver
note: 16-channel servo PWM. Logic 5 V from the UBEC, servos on the pack.

title: Regulator
note: Logic rail only. Servo current does not pass through it.

title: IMU
note: Mount on the deck centreline, connectors aft.

title: Camera
note: 8 mm class lens, behind the hood.

title: Ultrasonic
note: Crop-height / obstacle ping. Optional on tall grass.

title: Power switch
note: Pack disconnect on the rear panel.

title: M3×16 SHCS
note: Flange stacks that include a horn.

title: M3 nyloc nut
note: Nyloc, inside the shell where a boss is not used.

title: M3 heat-set insert
note: Six deck bosses plus four yaw-clamp ears.

title: Inline fuse 30 A
note: On the pack lead, before the servo rail
